verdict.rationale: Insomnia sits in the API lifecycle, so an APIOps question is fair to ask of it. However, the evidence only shows adjacent capabilities: Git Sync stores project and spec data in a Git repo, and the Inso CLI runs tests and lints OpenAPI specs in CI. Nothing documents declaring gateway or API infrastructure config and syncing or deploying it from CI, so these spec-as-code and testing features earn no credit for this story.
